(2) Selection Criteria:
Following  aspects  to  be  examined  by  the  Council  before
making its recommendations to the annual general meeting
of the Institute:-
(a)   Minimum fifteen years of service in the field of real
estate industry and profession in Sri Lanka;

(b)   Nominee’s 
outstanding 
contribution 
to 
the

advancement 
of 
the 
real 
estate 
industry 
and

Institute or Sri Lanka;
